description: Simplified aluminium mounting bracket (example from the project brief, extended with explicit precedence assumptions).

tools.description: 8 mm twist drill (diameter not checked in MVP)

precedence_constraints.rationale: Demo assumption: F1 is the datum face for this bracket and is machined before features located from it.
Demo assumption: pocket depth is dimensioned from F1, so F1 is machined first.

assumptions: Single setup is assumed for the demonstration.
Tool access and collision checks are not modelled in the MVP.
Precedence constraints are specific to this demo component and are not general manufacturing rules.

provenance.source: Adapted from the SCMPA project brief, section 4.1
provenance.notes: Hand-written toy specification for software testing; not derived from a real CAD model.
